title: The Lamp on the Peak
text: A single lamp burns on a peak no one could climb, a steady gold point high above the clouds. There is no path and no rope. Only someone who wants very little, the pilgrims say, is light enough to reach it.

options.label: The one who wants least goes up to the lamp.

outcomes.text: They come down quieter, with gold in their eyes. Now they know which way to go.

options.label: The strongest climbs by sheer will against the mountain.

outcomes.text: Somehow they reach it, fingers bleeding. The lamp is warm in their hands.

options.label: Leave it; it is not meant for you.

outcomes.text: The lamp goes out as you leave. The dark that follows is deeper than before, and your eyes are slow to find their way in it.
